title: Physics evidence baseline on current main: full heavy suite + six-DOF fleet + fingerprints on exact da67341, before any physics package
title_th: บันทึกฐานหลักฐานฟิสิกส์บน main ปัจจุบัน: รัน heavy ทั้งชุด + six-DOF fleet + fingerprints บน da67341 ก่อนเริ่มงานฟิสิกส์ใด ๆ
sources: PROGRESS:R0 row ("R0 fleet evidence/physics programme audit remains future work")
status_evidence: GitHub Actions heavy.yml: last full tests/heavy pass = run 36804343856 on 9f9f36a (2026-10-01, BEFORE #36 merged; 9f9f36a does not contain 17bd60f); last six-DOF fleet pass = run 36942933112 on 91ee372 (contains #36/#63/#64/#65) with the heavy job skipped. Since then #68 (Stage 2 workers), #70 and #71 (R1.4: finite main/RCS fuel, targetAttitude near-parallel basis fix in rigid/runtime.ts) changed shared physics; the R1.4 report ran 124 selected checks plus a named heavy gate (rendezvous + historical-docking), explicitly "not full heavy/fleet scientific acceptance". R2 (#74) changed no physics file. So no full heavy run has ever passed in CI on a main that contains #36, and no fleet run on a main that contains R1.4.
placement: R2 close-out gate (physics evidence) = PLAN R0.1 physics part; Q
priority_rationale: Every identical-output package (E track) and every R4 before/after table needs a recorded, green, exact-source baseline; without it a regression from R1.4 cannot be told from a regression of the next package (data safety of the goldens, realism).
acceptance: heavy.yml workflow_dispatch suite=both on exactly da67341 (or the R2 close-out head) green; exact-source union aggregation (R1.5) recorded with commit, Node 22.23.3, Chromium version and every fingerprint/golden file SHA-256 in a short report under docs/development/reports/; any red case is filed as a named regression against R1.4/#68/#70 BEFORE any new physics work, never re-recorded.
quality_guard: Run only; no code, golden or tolerance change. If something is red, bisect between 91ee372/9f9f36a and da67341 instead of re-recording.
user_benefit: Teachers and students keep flying the same validated flights; later speed-ups can be proven to change nothing.
notes: About 25 min heavy + 2 h 40 min fleet machine time (devplan W0-2). The weekly cron (Sun 20:07 UTC) would cover heavy on 2026-10-04 but the monthly fleet cron not until 2026-11-01, so dispatch explicitly.

title_th: สร้างชุดทดสอบเทียบผลแบบ bitwise ที่ฐานปัจจุบัน (กรณี Cowell, fingerprint Apollo 11, ตัวนับการเรียก deriv, ความเป็น deterministic ของ MSIS) ก่อนงานลดงานซ้ำ
status_evidence: origin/main: no Cowell bitwise harness and no Apollo fingerprint exist (existing tests/propagator.test.ts, msis.test.ts, lunar-ephemeris.test.ts, heavy/history-sixdof.test.ts are tolerance-based). src/physics/propagator/msis.ts keeps module-level COMMON-block state (apdf, dfa, tzOut, plg, gsurf, re, dm28 ...; densm reads tzOut set by an earlier routine), so MSIS call-history independence is unproven.
placement: Q (E-track prerequisite; physics owner P, tests only)
priority_rationale: The owner requires changes whose results stay exactly the same; this harness is the proof instrument for M-PHYSICS-010..015 and costs nothing at runtime.
acceptance: New tests only (no existing test edited): (1) ~6 fixed propagate() cases (LEO 400 km ALL_FORCES 30 d, GTO sun/moon/srp, untilDown eccentric, forced rejections tol=1e-12, onProgress abort) serialised as Float64 hex; (2) Apollo 11 adv mission TLI->entry SHA-256 of [t,r,v] each second + event log, Object.is on targetMidcourse/targetEntry/coastToPerilune; (3) deriv-call spy; (4) MSIS determinism: same input after different preceding inputs -> Object.is-equal density. Recorded on the M-PHYSICS-001 base, pinned Node 22.23.3.
quality_guard: Adds guards only. If (4) fails, the FSAL part of M-PHYSICS-010 is dropped (not identical).
user_benefit: Lets the team speed up lifetime, re-entry and Apollo calculations with proof that no number moves.
notes: Apollo fingerprint must stay in the heavy tier if it exceeds the default-suite time budget (PLAN 9.2: never drop heavy cases from shared-physics checks).

title: Flight-worker cost baseline: CPU profile of a six-DOF flight in the worker (requested 100x warp achieves only ~8.3x), feeding D-27 and the P17 package
title_th: วัดต้นทุน flight worker: profile CPU ของเที่ยวบิน six-DOF (ขอเร่ง 100x ได้จริงราว 8.3x) เพื่อใช้ตัดสิน D-27 และงาน P17
status_evidence: scratchpad/perf-baseline/results/baseline-fbefa18.md (3 runs, Falcon 9 / Cape / LEO default model): flight at requested 100x -> "sim s per wall s" 8.32 (7.8-8.46) with renderer DedicatedWorker ~790 ms CPU per wall s, i.e. the flight worker is saturated; at 1x it is 0.99 with 17.5 ms/s. No worker-side CPU profile exists (profile-fbefa18 covers the main thread only). DECISIONS D-27 (measure phones at 4x CPU before choosing the default flight model) still has no perf-budget journey.
placement: Q (physics owner P; perf journey by the perf/CI group)
priority_rationale: Six-DOF is the default for every vehicle; fast-forward is capped by worker CPU, so the hot spots must be known before choosing what to optimise (no speed claims without evidence).
acceptance: node --cpu-prof (and one in-browser worker trace) of Soyuz-2.1a and Falcon 9 six-DOF ascents: self time by function/file, GC time, allocation bytes per simulated second; 5 runs; committed as a report with machine/Node/Chromium identity. Result ranks integrator vs aero/engine/flex/navigation cost and sets the measurable target for M-PHYSICS-012.
quality_guard: Measurement only. Do not "solve" D-27 by switching phones to point-mass by default (realism loss): first make six-DOF cheaper with identical output; if phones still miss the budget, offer point-mass as a labelled choice, not a silent default.
user_benefit: Faster, smoother fast-forward on school tablets once the real bottleneck is fixed.
notes: Absolute numbers from the SwiftShader container are relative only (perf-baseline README); worker CPU per simulated second is hardware-transferable as a ratio.

Unchanged since fbefa18 (R2 did not touch src/physics).
